title: Noor and the Static
author: Ivo Montrose
blurb: Emrys Coldharbour, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
